wizard.title: New project
wizard.subtitle: Set the project up step by step. Everything except the basics can be changed later.
wizard.notAllowed: You cannot create projects. Ask an organization administrator.
wizard.partial: Some parts could not be set up; fix them in the project settings:
wizard.repositoryHint: The application repository QualityOS reads commits and changes from. You can skip this.
wizard.issue_trackerHint: Where approved defects are filed. You can skip this.
wizard.noConnections: No connection of this kind exists yet. Add one in Integrations, or skip this step.
wizard.capabilitiesOk: This connection meets every required capability.
wizard.capabilitiesMissing: This connection cannot serve the role. Missing: {list}.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.keyHint: Starts with a letter, 2–10 letters or digits. Used in ids such as PAY-TC-12; it cannot change later.
wizard.keyInvalid: Start with a letter; use 2–10 letters or digits.
wizard.templateHint: A template presets testing rules, execution policy and quality targets.
wizard.environmentHint: The application under test. Test runs may only reach this host. You can add more later.
wizard.membersHint: Add people now or later. Each person has one role in the project.
wizard.noOtherUsers: There is nobody else in the organization yet. Invite people from Users.
wizard.creatorNote: You become the project's QA lead.

health.title: Integration health
health.noneHint: Bind a repository or an issue tracker in the Bindings tab.
health.optionalMissing: {count, plural, one {# optional capability missing} other {# optional capabilities missing}}

project.upcomingHint: Requirements, test cases and runs appear here once those modules are built.

settings.name: Name
settings.keyImmutable: Keys are part of every id, so they never change.
settings.templateHint: Saves settings and environments; test logins are never copied.
settings.archivedHint: The project is archived: read-only and hidden from default lists.
settings.deleteConfirm: Type {key} to delete the project. Its key stays reserved; the audit history is kept.
settings.archiveHint: Archiving makes the project read-only and hides it from default lists. You can restore it.

environments.title: Environments
environments.noneHint: Add the application under test, e.g. staging.
environments.name: Name
environments.listHint: One per line, or separated by commas.
environments.allowedHostsHint: Test runs may reach only these hosts. Empty: the hosts of the base URLs. Use *.example.com for subdomains.
environments.resetHookHint: Optional https URL called before runs; its host must be allowed.
environments.authSecretKeep: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
environments.authSecretHint: Write-only: stored in the secret store and never shown again.
environments.isProduction: Production environment (only read-only smoke runs, with approval)

bindings.checkOk: The connection meets every required capability.
bindings.familyMismatch: This kind of connection cannot serve this role.
bindings.confirmEnd: End this binding? Its history and the items it brought in are kept.

rules.field_allowProductionSmoke: Allow read-only smoke runs on production
rules.field_dataSharingConsent: Redacted project content may be sent to the AI provider

members.noCandidates: Everyone in the organization is already a member. Invite new people from Users.
members.title: Members

policies.selfApprovalHint: Used only when the project has exactly one eligible approver; such decisions are flagged in the audit log.

hub.title: Integrations
hub.subtitle: Connections to source control, trackers and AI providers. Credentials are write-only.
hub.noneHint: Pick a provider from the catalog below.
hub.name: Name
hub.baseUrlHint: Only when the provider needs one (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/your-org).
hub.credentialHint: Write-only: stored encrypted, never shown again. Use a token with the least scopes needed.

connection.noCapabilities: This provider declares no capabilities yet.
connection.rotateHint: The old value is destroyed. The connection is tested again right away.
connection.webhookOnce: Copy these values now: the path token and signing secret are shown only once.
connection.webhookNone: No webhook endpoint. Polling keeps data current without one.
connection.retireHint: Retiring destroys the credential. Items it brought in stay readable, marked as from a retired source.
connection.impactBindings: These project bindings will stop working:

admin.inviteAsAdmin: Also make them an organization administrator
admin.inviteHint: Email delivery comes later; copy the link and send it yourself.
admin.projectKeysHint: Project keys separated by commas; empty means every project.
